BiblicalUsage: Jeshochajah is Jeshohaiah, an Israelite of Simeon. In 1 Chronicles 4:36, Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that Jeshohaiah belongs in the story because God put the name there, and I trust the placing.
